scope: Fresh pinned VC5 x86 native/source comparison for successful ENG1 RVA 0x2b130 factory/callback paths. The native side enters the read-only oracle and executes its real acquire, normal/middle/alternate factory, allocator and initializer bodies. The source side calls the canonical ordinary-C 0x2b130 producer plus the real action_registry, actor-pool initializer/allocator, actor_factories, spawn_services middle factory, and bounded worklist-read guard providers. Synthetic pools, asset/callback rows, registry group, and a test callback are controlled fixture state; no production capacity or callback-body claim is made.

oracle.extent_caveat: 0x1f0-byte diagnostic inventory includes six trailing alignment NOPs and is not an ownership claim.
oracle.process_local_data_overrides: Only measured loader data cells required for the fixture were redirected to process-local actor pools, asset/callback rows and the single test group. Every written DLL cell was snapshotted and restored before FreeLibrary; code bytes were never written.

check_accounting: Each pair:18 native/source field comparisons and15 grouped controlled invariants, including factory identity and old/new sentinel words. This is finite comparison accounting, not whole-function equivalence.
limits: Three controlled kinds exercise only one bounded actor slot and one callback row per family; no production pool or table capacity is inferred.
Test callback behavior is a controlled live-mutation probe, not a claim about the semantics of any production callback body.

Fixture group backing is 64 bytes to safely observe the native post-callback count=2 then entry[3] write. This does not enlarge or assert the production allocator request; the existing allocation-limit quirk remains unresolved.
Asset image/frame/step pointers address shared marker bytes. Their pointee behavior is not tested.

The source path uses the already integrated canonical provider and existing real helpers; it does not prove original source/TU identity, strict function equality, complete startup/gameplay equivalence, or dynamic group/pool capacities.
Callback tables and assets are synthetic fixture data registered with the actual bounded source guard; this does not validate all table entries or production callback semantics.

callback_and_fixture_endpoints.test_callback: Same host executable callback is installed in native and source test tables. It mutates group count to 2, original record sprite to 0x1357, child+0x34 to 0xfedc, and parent+0x118 to a replacement list with a zero sentinel at index 1.
